title: 第三章 反派师尊第四章 极限运动
slug: 穿进男频爽文反派师尊科学修仙
lines: 解清玄硬着头皮跳上叶问秋的浮空小舟，自身体重压得小舟在空中沉浮之时她顿时心下一紧。
嗯，她一介凡人，还是不太能接受这种毫无保护措施的高空飞行载具。
叶问秋向她微微颔首示意后便催动小舟缓缓升高，飞过解清玄的仙府小院，随后飞出她洞府所在的峭山，向着群山之中最高的那一座主峰驶去。
叶问秋将船开得很慢很稳，解清玄觉得自己好像是在坐观光缆车。
阳光透过巨大的云朵缝隙，在绿毯般的连绵群山上洒下斑驳金光，树木覆盖的山体，绿意盎然，生机勃勃，几条点着金色闪片的青色水带环绕山间，与穿梭奔走的飞禽走兽一起点缀着山间。
一切都是那么的清晰，鲜活。
微风拂过解清玄的发梢，她不由地深吸了一口气，裹着水汽的青草香味顿时涌入胸腔。她伸出手，感受着指间缠绕的风，那轻柔的触感无比真实。
她有多久没有看到过这般景色了？又有多久没有去感受阳光与清风的温度了？
她恍然，她意识到自己的上一辈子是真的结束了。
这一刻实验室中各种仪器在她脑内刻下的电子嗡名声终于消失了。
叶问秋微微侧目回首，见解清玄望着远处群山出神不由笑问：“清玄在想什么？修炼，还是收徒的事？”
解清玄也不由露出浅笑：“都在想。”
她在想自己上辈子确实还没活够，但这辈子好像也不赖。
叶问秋是个健谈且温和的人，一路上向她跟进了一下她闭关这几年门派内发生的事。
她不敢已读乱回，全程的回答基本就是那两个字：“嗯。”和“好。”
叶问秋从未露出被冒犯到的表情，面容语气一直那么柔缓甚至和蔼。
兴许是美好环境所致，又许是叶问秋用了些让人平静下来的小法术，在与他交谈相处时解清玄觉得自己如浸入温泉一般平和舒坦，整个人放松了许多。
转眼二人已到达主峰之巅。
流云宗的正堂大殿气势恢宏却装潢朴素。
二人到时，殿中已经来了不少人。
几个正座之上都是一个萝卜一个坑地，坐满了仙风道骨的流云宗长老。见叶问秋入殿，他们纷纷起身行礼。
叶问秋温和笑着颔首回礼，随后走上了正中间的正位。他的右手边还有一个坑位，想必那就是解清玄她该去的地方了。
解清玄不太知道原主是怎么与这些“路人”长老相处的，只是从书中人设中了解他骨子里十分淡薄应当不是会与别人热情打招呼的类型。
于是，她就那么冷着脸跟在叶问秋后面，一声不吭地径直走去自己的位置。坐下后她也是不敢随意张望环顾，就盯着面前那方讲台似的瘦高石桌，静候掌门发话。
难得今年内门拜师会上五位流云长老都到齐了，叶问秋满意点头，开始按部就班地主持拜师流程。
解清玄一脸冷漠地听着，见众人的注意力都转向掌门还有刚被带上来的那十五六个少年少女，她的眼睛也把持不住开始不安分起来。
‘所以，哪个小可爱会是男主呢？’
看着那些待分配的少年们她难免会有些好奇，但一时半会儿确实没法在这群俊男美女里面找出那个原著中描写为“相貌平平”的男主。
一番猜测无果，她也只得耐心等待。若是剧情没出什么问题，她只要不去主动生乱，那男主必定会被叶问秋分配到她门下。
“水，木，土，三项地灵根。源述长老，这孩子虽试炼成绩并不出众，但灵力性向实在与你契合，不如就由你来带他吧。”
终于，掌门叶问秋转向解清玄点头一笑。
源述是解清玄的道号，她稍微有些走神，一时没有反应过来。直到所有人的目光都集中在她身上，她方才感受到空气中的尴尬。
content_en:
Jie Qingxuan bravely jumped onto Ye Wenqiu's floating boat. Her own weight made the boat float in the air, and her heart suddenly tightened.
Well, as a mortal, she still couldn't accept such a high-altitude flying vehicle without protection.
Ye Wenqiu nodded to her slightly and then urged the boat to rise slowly, flying past Xie Qingxuan's small courtyard of the Immortal Mansion, and then flew out of the steep mountain where her cave was located, heading towards the highest peak among the mountains.
Ye Wenqiu drove the boat slowly and steadily, and Xie Qingxuan felt like he was riding a sightseeing cable car.
The sun shines through huge gaps in the clouds, casting mottled golden light on the green-carpet-like mountains. The mountains covered with trees are full of green and vibrant. Several blue water ribbons dotted with golden glitter surround the mountains, dotted with the birds and animals running back and forth.
Everything is so clear and vivid.
The breeze blew through Jie Qingxuan's hair, and she couldn't help but take a deep breath. The scent of green grass wrapped in water vapor suddenly poured into her chest. She stretched out her hand and felt the wind wrapped around her fingers. The gentle touch was extremely real.
How long had it been since she had seen such a scene? How long has it been since you felt the warmth of the sunshine and breeze?
She suddenly realized that her previous life was really over.
At this moment, the electronic buzz carved into her mind by the various instruments in the laboratory finally disappeared.
Ye Wenqiu looked back slightly and realized that Qingxuan was looking at the mountains in the distance in trance and couldn't help but smile and asked: "What is Qingxuan thinking about? Cultivation, or is it about accepting disciples?"
Xie Qingxuan couldn't help but smile: "I'm thinking about it all."
She was thinking that she had indeed not lived enough in her previous life, but it seemed that this life was not bad either.
Ye Wenqiu is a talkative and gentle person. Along the way, he followed up with her on what happened in the sect during the past few years since she was in retreat.
She didn't dare to read the reply randomly, and the whole answer was basically the same two words: "Yeah." and "Okay."
Ye Wenqiu never showed an offended expression, and his face and tone were always so gentle and even kind.
Maybe it was due to the beautiful environment, or maybe Ye Wenqiu used some little calming spells. When talking to him, Xie Qingxuan felt as peaceful and comfortable as if he was immersed in a hot spring, and he relaxed a lot.
In a blink of an eye, the two of them had reached the top of the main peak.
The main hall of Liuyun Sect is majestic but plainly decorated.
When the two arrived, many people were already in the hall.
Above the several main seats are carrots and pits, filled with immortal Liuyun Sect elders. Seeing Ye Wenqiu entering the palace, they all stood up and saluted.
Ye Wenqiu nodded with a gentle smile and then walked up to the seat in the middle. There is a pit to his right, and that must be where Jie Qingxuan should go.
Xie Qingxuan didn't know much about how the original owner got along with these "passerby" elders. He just knew from the character description in the book that he was very indifferent and was not the type to greet others warmly.
So, she followed Ye Wenqiu with a cold face and walked straight to her seat without saying a word. After sitting down, she didn't dare to look around at will. She just stared at the tall and thin stone table like a podium in front of her, waiting for the leader to speak.
It was rare that all five Liuyun elders were present at this year's inner sect apprenticeship meeting. Ye Wenqiu nodded with satisfaction and began to preside over the apprenticeship process step by step.
Jie Qingxuan listened with an indifferent expression. Seeing that everyone's attention turned to the leader and the fifteen or sixteen boys and girls who had just been brought up, she couldn't control her eyes and began to become restless.
‘So, which cutie will be the male protagonist? ’
She was inevitably a little curious when she looked at the boys to be assigned, but for a while she really couldn't find the male protagonist described as "plain-looking" in the original work among these handsome men and beauties.
After some guessing, she had no choice but to wait patiently. If there are no problems in the plot, as long as she doesn't take the initiative to cause trouble, the male protagonist will definitely be assigned to her by Ye Wenqiu.
"Water, wood, and earth are the three spiritual roots of the earth. Elder Yuanshu, although this child's test results are not outstanding, his spiritual aptitude is really in line with you, so why not let you take care of him."
Finally, the leader Ye Wenqiu turned to Xie Qingxuan and nodded with a smile.
Yuan Shu was Jie Qingxuan's Taoist name. She was a little distracted and didn't react for a moment. It wasn't until everyone's eyes were focused on her that she felt the embarrassment in the air.
